checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed (avoiding Cycle 1 duplicates) and scored; Tether Twins selected, Pulse Grid as fallback.

Delegated to an Opus 5 subagent per pipeline instructions. Spring-tether physics (semi-implicit integration, circle-vs-rect collision), exact dual-input scheme (WASD/arrows resolved simultaneously per-frame), 3-level LEVELS data format with concrete layouts, win/hazard-reset/restart flow, 13 tunable constants, and a window.__tetherTwins test-hook spec (getters, not snapshot props -- explicitly avoids Cycle 1's test-hook staleness bug) with 4 planned Playwright assertions.

cycle1Checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored; Orbit Duel selected, Gravity Flip Runner as fallback.
Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture, tunable constants, testing plan defined.
Self-contained playable prototype: 2-player local gravity-duel arcade game, no build step, no external assets/deps.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium smoke tests: load+interaction test and ~6s extended-session test, both PASS. Found and fixed one test-hook staleness bug (window.__orbitDuel.bullets snapshot vs live getter) during testing. Win-condition end-to-end and fun/balance tuning are NOT covered by automated tests -- flagged as follow-up.

cycle1FollowUps: Human/manual playtest of Orbit Duel for feel/balance tuning (SHIP_THRUST, SHIP_DRAG, G, BULLET_SPEED).
Automated end-to-end test of the win condition + restart flow.
Consider a simple AI opponent or additional modes if this concept is revisited in a future cycle.
